title: Bertonio Aymara
notes: Digitised edition of Ludovico Bertonio's Vocabulario de la Lengua Aymara (Juli, 1612), distributed as a StarDict dictionary in the native-dics repository of Amos Batto (https://github.com/amosbatto/native-dics). The text is not a diplomatic transcription: the orthography was modernised by Radio San Gabriel, and the dictionary was digitised by ILLA-A. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
